title: Senior Product Manager
searchText: Senior Product Manager Flexport About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The opportunity: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Billing & FInTech integrations for our Omnichannel Fulfillment division. As the Sr. Product Manager for Billing & Fintech Automation, you will own the financial engine that powers our logistics ecosystem. You’ll be responsible for transforming complex logistics events into seamless, automated financial transactions. Your goal is to build a billing infrastructure that is as fast and reliable as our physical supply chain. Why this challenge matters: Billing is often the last thing companies think about, but it’s the first thing customers notice when it goes wrong. By automating the "Fin" in "Fintech Logistics," you are directly impacting Flexport’s bottom line and removing the friction that holds global trade back. You will: Vision & Strategy: Define the multi-year roadmap for billing automation, revenue recognition, and fintech integrations within the Fulfillment sector. Complex Logic Modeling: Translate intricate logistics contracts and pricing models into scalable code-driven billing logic. Fintech Innovation: Explore and implement automated payment solutions, credit management, and real-time financial reporting for our global customer base. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Sales to ensure that every "shipment out" results in an accurate "invoice out" with zero manual intervention. Data Integrity: Ensure 100% accuracy in financial data flow between our Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP systems. You should have: Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, specifically within Fintech, SaaS Billing (ERP/Quote-to-Cash), or Logistics Tech . Systems Thinking: You can map out how a physical action in a warehouse triggers a financial event in a ledger. Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of APIs, SQL, and financial reconciliation workflows. Problem-Solving Grit: Logistics is messy. You need the ability to find elegant, automated solutions for edge cases and "broken" data. Communication: The ability to explain complex financial logic to a software engineer and high-level business impact to a CFO. Demonstrated ability to drive results in complex, regulated industries (Logistics, Fintech, Healthcare, etc.). Experience owning a product roadmap and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., revenue growth, efficiency gains). Bonus points if you have: Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, or high-volume transactional billing systems. A background in 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) or E-commerce fulfillment. #LI-onsite The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits): $155,520 — $194,400 USD Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
